verdict.rationale: Exporting data is a fair question for a data-sync and search platform, so the axis applies. However, no evidence documents a bulk export of collections or synced data in open formats. Self-hosting from the open-source repo and the search, API and MCP access paths are adjacent capabilities, not a documented export-and-leave feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
